paired_confirmation_test.unit: participant-level paired loss or utility difference
paired_confirmation_test.independence: new confirmation participants collected only after model and thresholds freeze

decision_policy.development_stage: Use rehearsal-observed completion and quality rates to replace assumptions before opening a formal development cohort.
decision_policy.confirmation_stage: Recruit a new participant cohort after all model choices, thresholds, exclusions, and utility metrics are frozen.
decision_policy.subgroups: If the planned subgroup count cannot be reached, report descriptive uncertainty and do not claim subgroup equivalence.
decision_policy.gaze: Behavioral labels remain usable when gaze abstains; word-level gaze claims require the independent quality band.
